(2) Inventory/Catalog part DELETE succeeded - POST /api/inventory/parts/delete returned 201. FAIL is specifically for 'delete part sales': the UI offers a Delete control but the backend blocks it (403) because part-sale deletion is wired to the Work Orders Delete permission (workOrdersDelete) rather than Part Sales Delete (partSalesDelete). This is both a UX bug (control shown when it will always be denied) and a permission-mapping inconsistency vs the spec's 'Part Sales Delete'.
